setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays pattern 1 through a MIDI device: four trigs on steps 1 to 4 with the notes C, D, E and F (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) at velocities 127, 117, 107 and 97. Nothing else exists yet: no second pattern, no scale change and no second channel.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Tap Pattern (5,8) to open Pattern Trig, choose pattern 2 at (2,1) and tap steps 1 and 3. Both steps light on the grid.
steps.title: Add trigs to pattern 2

steps.caption: Tap Pattern (5,8) again for Pattern Note. Raise step 1 to the cell (1,4) and step 3 to (3,6): these are the scale degrees 4 and 6 that pattern 2 plays on those steps. Both cells light.
steps.title: Raise their notes

steps.caption: Tap Scale (4,8) and tap slot 2 at (2,3). Turn E2 to Root, turn E3 two detents up to D and press K3. The Scale screen names slot 2 and D major is applied.
steps.title: Apply D major

steps.caption: Tap Channel (3,8) and tap pattern slot (2,2). Pattern 2 now plays on channel 1 beside pattern 1, and both slot buttons are lit.
steps.title: Give pattern 2 to channel 1

steps.caption: Press Play, then Stop. By default overlapping trigs are skipped, so steps 1 and 3, where both patterns have a trig, drop out. Only steps 2 and 4 play: look at the MIDI strip, "MIDI sent in this step", for E and G of D major, MIDI 64 and 67, at velocities 117 and 97.
steps.title: Hear Skip

title: Add a second pattern in D major
